---
name: implement-feature
description: Deliver the requested feature with scoped delegation and evidence-based verification.
agent: orchestrator
---

Implement the feature requested by the user using
[the shared workflow](../../agent-system/workflows/feature-delivery.md).
If no feature has been specified, ask for the goal instead of inventing one.
Choose the risk route, establish observable criteria and delegate bounded work.
Keep project discovery proportional and do not assume technology or test commands.
Report real checks and independent verdicts; missing gates are blockers, not success.
